sentences.en: Horses have three modes of locomotion: Walk, trot and gallop.
sentences.zh: 马有三种运动方式：行走、小跑和奔驰。

sentences.en: I think I hear three or four horses galloping together.
sentences.zh: 我觉得听到三四匹马一起飞驰的声音。

sentences.en: The cavalry galloped to the capital to report their victory.
sentences.zh: 骑兵们飞驰到首都报告他们的胜利。

senses.zh: 急速进行；飞驰；急急忙忙地说
